items.note: S1.1.1-S1.1.5 follow the proof row by row: the old scratch is cancelled, the net change is (JV+RG)x, the central coefficients are |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, and the three stages give (-y,x). The gate maps, the neighbour rules and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are not written out, but they are not part of the lemma's proof.

Covers the invariant (stored array = D_v applied to the logical array), commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, with auxiliary roles included, as at 804-825.

Nesting, the single decreasing edge type (center 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are all stated. The two label fields and forms (Q^h with I-J/9; F_2^h with the dot product) are never given, and |S∩T|-1 is presented as holding in both. The gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and the edge-by-edge residual table that prove comparability are not reproduced; S1.4.1.3 only quotes their conclusion.

Covers the projections P_U and -P_{U_a}, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the 2P_{U_a} source exception, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and the endpoint differences P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (zero to identity on every other role), which give H<-H+D on every row through Phi frames (S2.2.3-S2.2.4).

The kernel-per-residual-vector factorization, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and C^{⊗m} on every role (with the Z-repair of X_a->Y_a) are stated. The phase frame C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{q_U})H^{⊗m} and a,b are never defined. S1.6.1 only restates the proposition: the proof's mechanism (weight additive mod 4 on orthogonal parts, odd weights giving ±1, Hadamard conjugation of (-1)^{v·x} to X_v; 1232-1257) is missing.

Covers L/N<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, s_c<W_c m, eta>20·2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, exactly as at 1331-1346. The exact eta fractions are not given, but only the bound is used.

The plan uses the primitives (cyclic row split into W streams, lower-triangular updates 'by the controlled shifts lemma', single-digit moves), but no step states either lemma's content: O(V) digit operations, or y->y+a(controls) mod q^b with b^{O(1)} offset preparation.

Follows the pivot elimination (topmost row, rightmost entry, lower-triangular clearing), the O(V) triangular transforms in descending order, the sandwich E_2, E_1^{-1}, Pi, E_1, E_2^{-1}, and the one-interchange realisation D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j, exactly as at 1375-1447.

Covers the cyclic row split, Phi_{A_e} by recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, merging back, the three-shear swap, exactly s calls of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum, and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule.

Covers the high-digit row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, base-m pieces with the sum O(Ve^tau), padding binary ranges to [q^e], and unequal widths, as at 1649-1762. The formulas for k and rho are not given.

Covers the edge product over a residual basis, conjugation by P_M with the basis as the first columns, child calls (C^{eps})^{⊗f} on slots, the inverse-child identity, exactly s_c children giving C^{⊗e}, the row-addition decomposition of GL(m,F_2), and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D.

Follows the proof: the two 3-cycles and the eight-operation result, packed cyclic shifts, the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, the union bound delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, the rank-counter extraction and radix-sort repair, the omitted top position, and the cost terms.

Covers the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows sent to roles, V/W children, the recurrence with leaves O(e), the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). Missing is K<=d^c<=e^{c/beta}, which turns the overhead into O(e^{tau(1+c/beta)})=O(e^lambda) and is where tau(1+c/beta)<lambda enters (2413-2415). The q_0 row construction appears only as 'obtain rows from the first few chunks'.

The O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer with one final truncation below sqrt2·2^{-p} is assembled along the paper's route. The guard-width bound is only asserted in S3.5 (E, B, C_1=20, ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}), eps·C_1<1); the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E and its unrolling (2479-2560), which justify it, are missing.

Covers character cancellation, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage B_t, the reverse procedure, grouping into H followed by J_E, prefix-slot moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, the per-round layer, signed-shift monomials, the l·sqrt2·2^{-p} error and LBF^- / F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}. Why the reverse procedure equals F^+B^{-1} (H_0^2=I/2) is passed over.
Follows the proof: B_0=2^{4p}, four signed evaluation products, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centred extraction with carry in {0,1}, negacyclic wrap, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost.

Covers retaining the LB order (pointwise products commute with a common record permutation), the normalization through F^-(f*g)=M F^-f F^-g and F^+F^-=I/M, the error 2delta+eta, then 3delta+eta, times M, and the M=T/r products.

Covers the cited Gaussian identity and ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2, the normalizations S', J', D' with product 2^{-2alpha^2}, the ordered numerical maps with error <p^2, the permutations kept in the identity, tensoring with gamma=2d·alpha^2, the line counts, and axis exposure O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

Covers the chirp's periodicity, the coefficient comparison for QF_t, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+, RF^+R=F^+, commutation with pointwise products, the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for RF^+.

Covers the fixed rationals, the size parameters, the Rosser-Schoenfeld interval count exceeding d, disjoint intervals, S/T>(1-1/(2d))^d>1/2, alpha^4·theta_i>3db>=6b=p, and the n^{o(1)} search. alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}) and eq:gamma (gamma<=b/4) are not written out; only gamma=o(b) appears in S6.7.7.

Follows the paper: the algebra map respects x^S=1 and is bijective on monomials; triangular digits b_i; updates in the order i=d..1 rotating only [0,s_i); prefix-controlled shifts; O(d^2) axis moves with cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

Covers well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, computed phases with error <2·2^{-p}, and the twist, ring-convolution, untwist sequence.

Covers the source transform (A, the chirp transform via complex convolution, B_0, 2^gamma) with exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, the pointwise product, the scales S and 2^{2b+4}S undoing (u*v)/S^2, and Phi^{-1} with carries. The input scale 2^{-b-2} is not stated explicitly.

Follows the chain E_ring<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9·2^gamma·TL, (2E_s+2), E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28·2^gamma·T^2·L, the final error <448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, and the carry invariant, as at 4557-4806. S6.7.2 drops the norm-0.7 operand hypothesis (listed as an error).

The seven rows with their powers of p, the margins g_1..g_7, min=g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the log-power absorption and the schoolbook cutoff all match. The o(V) bounds for recursion-node setup and for the exceptional-record sorting (4913-4981) are absent, which is conservatively counted as a missing step.
S0.1 states the eventual lower bound, its negation via liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, and the stronger limit zero, matching 379-387. It is a single quoted inference with no method or sub-steps.

errors.says: For triple indicator vectors <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, so every triple line is nondegenerate and neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal in the label field of either construction (also in the S1.3 method: 'whose pairings |S∩T|-1 make neighbouring triples orthogonal').
errors.paper: The pairing |S∩T|-1 holds only in the bit label space F=Q^h with form x^T(I-J/9)y. The complex network uses F=F_2^h with the ordinary dot product, where t_T·t_T=1 and neighbours (even intersection) are orthogonal mod 2. Neither form is given in the plan.

errors.says: The normalized ring convolution has error below E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL and its output has norm below .701, so it stays in the disk without clipping.
errors.paper: The norm bound .7+5TLh_p<.701 holds only when one operand has norm at most .7; the plan states it without this hypothesis.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}): scalar exchange, frames, labels, rank budget s<Wm and the exponent, then matrix shear and the interchange recurrence on the bit side, phase frames, packed additions and the layer recurrence on the complex side, then synthetic transforms, convolution, resampling with the chirp and cancellation, assembly, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins in five places. The network's fixed sizes (h=100, N, m=h^3) are never given. The complex phase interface is restated rather than derived. The layer recurrence skips K<=e^{c/beta}, which converts the overhead to e^lambda. The guard-width depth recurrence is omitted. The setup and exceptional-stream o(V) accounting is missing.

steps.note: The fixed linear network exchanging the banks as (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire is stated. h=100, the indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples of triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear (m is only 'the dimension'), so the defining sizes are missing.

Gives the common frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge only changing the frame, with the motivation that intermediate frames are free to be made cheap.
Gives nondegenerate subspace labels of F^{⊗3} (dimension m) common to each gate, comparable labels on every edge, and the central wires 3->4 as the only decreasing edges, each losing h.
S1.4.3.2 gives rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested U⊂V. S1.4.3.3-S1.4.3.4 give the N source exceptions: 2P_{U_a}, of rank one where the dimension change was zero.
Gives the sum of |Δdim| as Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from telescoping, terminal sums N and Wm-N, and Ic decreasing edges, and then s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
Gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0, and hence s<Wm.
Gives M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, including auxiliary roles, which through the Phi frames yields H<-H+D on every original row.
Gives A=E_1 Pi E_2, a shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge implemented by recursive interchanges, and exactly s recursive calls per node.
Gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta>20·2^{-50} with log m<20 giving s/W<m^tau for tau=1-2^{-50}, the geometric sum, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P04 reconstructs eight of the nine steps of the central saving, in order and with their defining quantities: frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, a rank-a shear as a recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Only the network's starting data falls short (C1): the exchange and restoration are there, but h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated.
